rendering.advice: Add <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1"> to the head; without it a mobile client renders at desktop width and scales the result down
rendering.message: The HTML declares no viewport, so a phone renders it at desktop width and scales the result down.

text_alternative.advice: Generate the text part from the HTML at send time, or send HTML alone; a text part that only announces the message is in HTML is what clients preferring text display
text_alternative.message: The plain text part carries a fraction of what the HTML says, rather than an alternative to it.
